intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정해서 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create and later visually validate one independently randomized, complex image concept that uses the attached image only to guide stable facial appearance. This arm realizes that request as a safe architectural and urban surreal editorial narrative featuring one clearly adult original woman.

Photorealistic surreal urban editorial, vertical full-body view of one unmistakably adult original woman in a monumental flood-control atrium beneath stacked expressways after rain. Her facial appearance is guided only by the provided reference image, while she remains a new fictional person in a wholly new scene. Wearing a modular navy raincoat over an ivory knit, tailored charcoal trousers, and waterproof ankle boots, she plants one boot on a low inspection curb and anchors a wind-pulled translucent city plan with both hands, peering through its contour lines toward the displaced skyline. Above her, hundreds of detached window bays align into a single impossible cresting wave, their frames reflecting teal drainage lights and amber roadway glow. Wet concrete, runoff channels, distant bridge piers, and fine mist remain physically tactile. Cyan-violet post-rain dusk, a slight low-angle 35 mm perspective, a clear full-body silhouette, controlled motion in the plan and coat hem, and deep architectural scale create a poised, uncanny civic-surreal narrative.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
